summary: Drops laravel/vapor-core: the public /vapor/signed-storage-url controller now builds the S3 presigned PUT itself (same behaviour, 5 min expiry in filesystems.php); bumps symfony/mime and @intlify tooling; api/vapor.yml stays but can no longer deploy without vapor-core.

statements.why: No login/payment/db/secret problem; signing behaviour intended identical. The Vapor deploy break is outside those areas (see misses).

statements.text: The vapor signed storage URL part of your server changed in a way plain can't describe yet. /vapor/signed-storage-url

statements.why: Removes vapor-core and deps, bumps symfony/mime.
True, but doesn't relay that Vapor deployments need vapor-core restored.

misses.what: If you deploy with Laravel Vapor (api/vapor.yml still present), deployments no longer work until laravel/vapor-core is restored; docker.mdx says so but the card doesn't. Docker/self-hosted unaffected.
File uploads to S3 are now signed by the app itself instead of the Vapor package, meant to behave the same; links still expire after 5 minutes.
Security updates: symfony/mime 7.4.19 -> 7.4.22 and @intlify tooling (vue-i18n-extensions 8 -> 9, needs Node 22+ for builds).
